verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly supports self-hosted deployment via the Linux package, Docker images, self-compile, and a Helm chart or Operator for cloud-native installs. It also documents scaling a self-hosted installation with recommended configurations. However, no evidence explicitly mentions high availability, replication, or failover topologies, so the HA part of the story is only implied by the scaling docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of HA/replicated reference architectures (database replication, failover, redundant application and Gitaly nodes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted HA deployment.
